topics.name: Federated and privacy-preserving analysis
topics.potential_use: Assess whether the distributed learning or privacy mechanism could inform multi-site PopPK estimation or model evaluation without exchanging patient-level data. Equivalence to pooled NLME estimation would require a separate test.

topics.name: Lymphatic and vascular disease biology
topics.potential_use: Examine whether the reported mechanism or measurement could inform a disease-state variable, parameter, or experimental endpoint in a QSP model of pediatric vascular anomalies. Transfer to KLA must be established separately.

topics.name: Mechanistic modeling and inference
topics.potential_use: Evaluate the method as a candidate for mechanistic PK/PD or QSP inference with sparse observations, focusing on identifiability, uncertainty, and out-of-sample prediction rather than assuming direct applicability.

topics.name: Endothelial signaling and targeted therapy
topics.potential_use: Consider the reported signaling relationship as a hypothesis for a vascular-disease QSP model or a targeted-therapy experiment. The connection is a research suggestion, not evidence for clinical benefit in KLA.

topics.name: Sequential treatment decisions
topics.potential_use: Assess whether the state representation, decision rule, or safety constraint could support longitudinal dose adaptation under partial observation. Clinical validation and a disease-specific objective would still be needed.

topics.name: Virtual cells and perturbation modeling
topics.potential_use: Explore whether the measurement or perturbation model could help connect cell-level experiments to latent disease states or drug-response components in QSP. A cell model is not automatically a validated virtual-patient model.

topics.name: Antibody disposition and delivery
topics.potential_use: Assess whether the mechanism could inform antibody clearance, absorption, or bioavailability assumptions in IV-to-SC bridging. Drug-specific parameterization and trial-design validation would be separate steps.
